scope: Actual bundled shared registry dispatch to existing physical CHR and FamiTone2 native/transcription models, physical identity/evidence, bounded operations and nonmutation. No universal engine recovery, browser rendering, listening or native/canonical equivalence claim.

results.name: Shared registry contains one existing CHR method and one native profile with honest independent operations
Pepsi discovery offers physical CHR while unknown native engine remains inspectable
HonkeyPong discovery recognizes native data while retaining strict general-header uncertainty
An explicitly normalized-header derivative independently offers physical CHR and native Audio
Native detection ignores source name and allows changed CHR bytes without an allowlisted ROM hash
The same shared path recognizes relocated code/data and NROM32 source derivatives
Unsupported mapper remains usable by general inspection and physical CHR recovery
CHR-RAM sources retain native Audio recovery without inventing physical graphics
Malformed and truncated files are invalid for the profile but remain open as raw analysis
Ambiguous reachable native initializations are not silently selected
Oversized physical sources are rejected before calling the native decoder
Shared CHR dispatch invokes real two-plane decoding and preserves legacy exact round trips
Native inspect dispatch invokes existing decoder and exposes bounded pages with exact command bytes
Malformed page options and stale expected identities refuse without side effects
Native patch dispatch changes only an actual command byte and returns distinct input/output identities
Unsafe native edits fail instead of becoming arbitrary ROM writes
Canonical dispatch invokes real transcription and retains editable patterns, source evidence and fidelity warnings
Recognized native Audio can explicitly refuse strict tuning, PAL, or malformed conversion options
Native copied edits can be reinspected and transcribed with their current exact source identity
Native transcription does not advertise or manufacture a source encoder or round-trip proof
The shared conversion result limit reports an honest refusal without retaining oversized data
Cooperative work exhaustion and cancellation preserve the original inspection and all application state
